Scope: sewage, storm water (to the ponds), irrigation and potable water networks, 13.8 kV medium-voltage cables, street lighting, telecom ducts and cables, internal and external roads with asphalt and sidewalks, the potable water and TSE pump stations, three lift stations and a mosque. Contract value SAR 560 million excluding VAT, 36 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-days. This week a full MODON weekly report workbook was uploaded, so the figures come from it rather than from the P6 file: its summary puts the project at 58.70% against 55.32% planned, 3.38% ahead, SPI 1.06. The P6 export inside the same workbook gives a lower 53.45% against 53.97% (SPI 0.99), and only 0.21% was earned this week against 0.66% planned.

The reported lead rests on figures that the workbook's own P6 data does not support. The summary's earned man-days exceed the budget in three areas (mosque 185%, irrigation 110%, earthworks for blocks 101%), and its total budget (169,568 man-days) differs from the P6 export (159,298). On the P6 basis the project is 0.52% behind its revised plan and 8.8% behind the original baseline (62.29% due by 01-Nov-2026). Earned man-days fell to 514 in October and 56 so far in November, against 8,136 planned for October, and this week's gain of 0.21% is a third of the 0.66% planned. Roads (34.9% against 51.8%) and street lighting (40.0% against 68.8%) are the weakest areas. The P6 update of 26-Oct-2026 finishes the project on 19-Mar-2028, 4 days after the contract date; the weekly report still forecasts 15-Mar-2028.

Data notes

  • Basis: this week's physical figures come from the MODON weekly report workbook (1111.xlsx, data date 02-Nov-2026). Its summary (58.70% against 55.32%) and its P6 export (53.45% against 53.97%) disagree; both are shown. The workbook also reports cost-based progress labelled "Earn Value", which is not used here.
  • In the summary, earned man-days exceed the budget for the mosque (3,783 of 2,044), irrigation (8,164 of 7,409) and earthworks for blocks, and planned irrigation is 109%. Landscape shows 2,680 earned man-days in the summary but 0 in the P6 export.
  • The Physical-Chart Data and Manpower sheets show actual man-days falling to 514 in October and 56 in November, while the summary reports 356 man-days earned this week.
  • Site handover is 16-Mar-2025 in the General Information sheet but 16-May-2025 (baseline) and 16-Apr-2025 (forecast) in the milestone table. The safety plan approval date is entered as 05-May-2028.
  • Milestone dates in the weekly report (road works 16-Jan-2026, deep works 16-Sep-2026) have passed but show "0 days change"; they disagree with the P6 update and with the report's Conclusion sheet.
  • The resource table gives 6,329 actual against 1,703.5 planned manual head count; 6,329 is September's man-day total. Saudi staff 52.
  • Procurement totals differ between files: MV cables 100,000 of 116,000 m in the MODON supplier sheet but 189,522 of 189,522 m in the Status of Procurement sheet; lighting poles 1,132 of 1,273 against 1,161 of 1,161; catch basin covers 1,373 against 1,441.
  • No new P6 file was uploaded this week; the P6 forecast (19-Mar-2028) is from the 26-Oct-2026 update. The invoice log numbers two invoices as 16, so the summary shows "−1" pending invoices. The tracker's Info sheet is still dated 15-Jun-2026.
